ev.q: is a 2009 first-person shooter survival horror video game
The game takes place inside the Chernobyl exclusion zone in Ukraine
which the player must take care of with medical supplies
post-apocalyptic horror, as well as tactical role-playing action
Upgrading has three tiers of improvement
Each of these is a large playable area
Bandits are ruthless and generally hostile to anyone not in their gang
